description: Game / ThreeJS Expert Pack invariants — 3D interactive, WebGL scene, asset management, game state rules

invariants.name: animation_loop_must_be_bounded
invariants.description: requestAnimationFrame loop must respect tab visibility, frame budget, and have a stop condition. Unbounded render loops degrade performance and battery.

invariants.name: assets_must_have_loading_error_handling
invariants.description: All asset loads (models, textures, sounds) must have error/retry/fallback handling. Failed loads must not crash the scene.

invariants.name: user_scene_data_must_be_validated
invariants.description: User-uploaded or user-edited scene data must be validated server-side. Malformed scene JSON must not crash renderer.

invariants.name: saved_scene_belongs_to_user
invariants.description: Server must enforce that user A cannot access/modify user B saved scenes

invariants.name: frame_budget_must_be_defined
invariants.description: Project must define a target frame budget (e.g., 16ms at 60fps) and document how it is measured/enforced

invariants.name: canvas_smoke_required_for_ui_surface
invariants.description: Any project with a 3D canvas surface must have a basic smoke test that verifies the canvas element exists, WebGL context is created, and initial render completes without errors

invariants.name: external_asset_urls_must_be_allowlisted
invariants.description: If loading assets from external URLs (CDN, third-party), the URLs must be from an allowlisted domain set. Arbitrary URL loading is a security risk.

invariants.name: game_state_transition_allowed
invariants.description: Game/scene state transitions must follow defined valid paths. Invalid state transitions must be rejected.

invariants.name: score_or_progress_cannot_be_client_trusted_if_competitive
invariants.description: If the project has competitive scoring or leaderboards, score/progress values must be validated server-side. Client-reported scores are not trustworthy.

invariants.name: webgl_context_loss_handled_or_documented
invariants.description: WebGL context loss events must be handled (recovery or graceful degradation) or explicitly documented as not handled with user-facing message

non_claims: This pack does NOT constitute a complete production game
This pack does NOT include Unity/Unreal integration
This pack does NOT handle multiplayer/netcode
This pack is a DESIGN AID — domain rules, invariants, and test patterns
